item.title: Bridge closed over I-75 as interstate shutdowns begin tonight
item.description: Lanes of Interstate 75 will close beginning Monday night for repairs to the County Road 320 overpass that was damaged by a dump truck last year, with concrete barriers and detour signs now in place to block traffic over the bridge. Read more: Bridge closed over I-75 as interstate shutdowns begin tonight

item.description: The McIntosh 1890s Festival was saved by town officials just one week after its longtime organizers announced the event would be permanently discontinued. Read more: McIntosh 1890s Festival saved by town council days after permanent cancellation

item.title: Lou Anne Adams
item.description: Lou Adams volunteered at Monroe Regional Hospital for 18 years. She, and her husband, Bob, loved to play basketball. She was a true blessing and faithful servant of God. Read more: Lou Anne Adams

item.title: Record number of Marion County schools earn national magnet awards
item.description: A record-breaking eight public schools in Marion County garnered national attention this week after receiving awards from Magnet Schools of America, including one school that earned the highest possible honor. item.title: Ocala man who chased, shot girlfriend at Motel 6 gets 20-year prison sentence
item.description: A convicted felon from Ocala will spend the next two decades in prison for shooting his girlfriend in the back while chasing after her at a local motel in 2024. Read more: Ocala man who chased, shot girlfriend at Motel 6 gets 20-year prison sentence
